description: Upgrades a Cassandra cluster one node at a time: drain, stop, upgrade package, start, verify UN. nodetool snapshot taken before upgrade. Partial rollback — upgraded nodes may require snapshot restore.

nodes.label: Cluster Nodes
nodes.description: List of {host, port, dc} for all cluster nodes

upgrade_delay_seconds.label: Delay Between Node Upgrades (s)
upgrade_delay_seconds.description: Seconds to wait between upgrading each node (default: 30)

dry_run.label: Dry Run
dry_run.description: Run preflight checks only — no changes applied

rollback.description: Per-node snapshot restore via nodetool refresh. Nodes not yet upgraded remain on old version. Cassandra SSTable format may prevent clean binary downgrade on upgraded nodes — snapshot restore is the safe path.

steps.description: nodetool status (all UN), version validation, gossip compatibility check
nodetool snapshot on all nodes, record snapshot tag
Per-node: drain → stop → upgrade package → start → verify UN
nodetool upgradesstables on all upgraded nodes
nodetool status all UN, version matches target on all nodes
